name: bui-booth-games
description: BUI expo booth kiosk games: an arcade of short security games (Phish or Safe?, Data Recovery Claw, Secure Stack, Firewall Frenzy, Patch Panic, Stronger Password?, Segment the Network, Byte Guard, Password Python). Fully offline.

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build --mode arcade && vite build --mode phish && vite build --mode claw && vite build --mode stack && vite build --mode firewall && vite build --mode patch && vite build --mode password && vite build --mode segment && vite build --mode byteguard && vite build --mode pythonpw
